Caveman
nodes.rationale: Compresses output tokens by ~65-75% via terse model response style; does not affect code, commits, security warnings, or error quotes.

nodes.label: Caveman isolated installer (lib/caveman/install.sh)
nodes.rationale: Standard caveman installer patches ~/.claude/settings.json which is incompatible with iclaude isolated env (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). Wrapper redirects all writes to .nvm-isolated/.claude-isolated/.

nodes.label: Caveman Auto-Clarity
nodes.rationale: Reverts to normal style for security warnings, irreversible action confirmations, multi-step sequences where fragment order increases misread risk, and clarification requests.

nodes.label: normalize-paths.py hook
nodes.rationale: Two-way PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook flips manifest, root, and cache/ast paths abs<->rel around every graphify invocation. Brittle workaround until upstream lands.

nodes.label: _patch_graphify_watch shim
nodes.rationale: Runtime shim that patches watch.py to pass manifest_path explicitly so manifest lands inside GRAPHIFY_OUT/.

nodes.label: Graphify portability patches (4 patches)
nodes.rationale: Upstream graphifyy writes absolute paths in manifest, .graphify_root, and cache; breaks the graph when the repo moves between machines. Four idempotent patches relativize paths so the graph is portable via git.

nodes.label: SSH ControlMaster + rsync sync
nodes.rationale: One persistent TCP connection for all sync ops reduces overhead from 150-320ms handshake to ~5ms; rsync delta-sync cuts transfer 90%+ on small changes.

nodes.label: Named microVM snapshots
nodes.rationale: Save full VM state (memory, disks, network) to skip cold kernel boot on resume; tied to specific Firecracker version (incompatible across upgrades, fallback to cold boot).

nodes.label: KVM hypervisor as security boundary
nodes.rationale: Capabilities inside the guest do not extend beyond the VM; any exploit remains isolated within guest kernel. Privilege escalation inside VM via SUID is acceptable since it does not breach KVM isolation.

nodes.label: Workspace sync modes (full/isolated)
nodes.rationale: full = bidirectional sync host<->guest; isolated = host->guest only, used to give claude read access while preventing modification of originals.
